title: STOPDT control exchange with command-path follow-up
purpose: Cover STOPDT U-format activation and confirmation, then exercise a distinct control-direction Single Command with a normal-operation cause and nonzero object address.
expected_behavior: The peer processes the STOPDT exchange and parses the subsequent Single Command frame as a distinct control-direction application path; malformed or disallowed state handling should return an error or protocol response rather than terminate the process.
constraints_preserved: U-format STOPDT activation and confirmation use four control octets and length 0x04.
Type 45 is the documented Single Command identifier.
The command ASDU preserves type, VSQ, two-octet cause, common address, three-octet IOA, and command qualifier ordering.
The I-format length 0x0e matches four control octets plus ten ASDU octets.
The payload is synthetic and does not copy issue 13 input.
issue_safety_notes: The sequence intentionally combines a link-state transition with a command parser path, but uses a short, nonhistorical payload and no oversized or repeated-zero body from the reported crash.
